Channel.description: A channel, DM or group DM.

assistant_reader_ids.description:
Assistants that read this DM or group DM through their pinned person. Empty (and absent) for
space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

closing.description:
A voice room K2 is closing: joins and moves into it are refused
(`409 conflict` `channel_closing`) and it is archived when its last person leaves.
Absent when `false`; never set on an archived channel.

created_by.description:
Who created the channel. Optional on the wire so older payloads still parse; the
server always sends it.

dm_member_ids.description: The DM's members; empty for space channels.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

file_retention_days.description: Effective file retention in days. Absent = forever.

has_guests.description: Whether any member of the channel or DM is a guest. Old payloads read as `false`.

head_seq.description: Head of the channel change log.

meeting.description: A meeting channel's meeting; absent on every other channel.

member_count.description: Joined members. Old payloads without it read as 0.

recording_audio_days.description:
The channel's default audio keep days for recordings; absent = the org
default.

recording_auto.description: Voice channels: a recording starts on the first join. Absent = off.

recording_require_consent.description:
Voice channels: declining the recording notice means not joining;
absent = the org policy `recording.require_consent_to_join`.

recording_rule.description:
Voice channels, DMs and group DMs: the rule the room records under, every source
applied: `auto` (a recording starts on the first join), `required` (every call with
more than one person is recorded) or `none` (people press Record). Absent = `none`.

retention_days.description: Effective message retention in days (holds ignored). Absent = forever.

slow_mode_s.description: Slow mode in seconds, 0 = off. Always sent; old payloads read as 0.

user_limit.description:
Voice channels: at most this many people in the call, 0 = no per-channel limit.
Absent (0) for other types.

visibility.description: Public or private; DMs are private.

ChannelMeeting.description: `meeting` on a meeting channel's JSON: the meeting it belongs to.

oneOf.description: An announcement channel: `@everyone` posts only in threads by default.
A 1:1 DM (no space, slug or name; always private).
A group DM of up to 9 people.

RecordingRule.description: The rule a voice room records under, as its settings and their sources resolve it.

oneOf.description: The room records from its first join.
The room records every call with two or more people.
Every space member can see and join it.

description: A page of an id-keyed list: `{"items": [...], "has_more": bool}`.

has_more.description: Whether more items exist past this page.

title: Page
